endorsements.name: Jonathan Butts
endorsements.label: When IoT Attacks: Understanding the Safety Risks Associated with Connected Devices
endorsements.description: The Internet of Things (IoT) is all around us, making our lives more convenient.  We've seen IoT devices being taken over to conduct DDoS attacks.  We've heard about connected refrigerators being used to SPAM users and baby monitors being used to scream obscenities at innocent infants, but could an IoT device be re-purposed to physically attack an unsuspecting user? Let's find out.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2017
